Bill.BriefDescription: Modernizing the Washington state ferry system.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to improving Washington state ferry service bymodernizing ferry fleet and organization; and creating new sections.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Following more than two years of study plusextensive public input, and noting recent declines in ferry fleet sizeand material readiness, the legislature finds that the current ferrysystem is not fully meeting the service requirements of the communitiesserved by this network of "marine highways." The legislature alsonotes that longterm resource requirements exceed current budgetprojections. Accordingly, it is the explicit intent of thelegislature: To establish the levels of service that amply meet theneeds of the communities and statewide economy served by the ferrysystem; to establish a framework for fleet and service modernizationthat will support sustained ferry construction; to implement costsaving efficiencies; and to upgrade organizational effectiveness.
This act may be known and cited as p. 1 SB 6061Washington's marine highway modernization act.
